verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a customer data platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a recurring schedule or workflow scheduler. Warehouse Sync is described only as ingesting data from warehouses, with no mention of schedules, intervals or recurring runs, and the audience and feed docs describe one-time connection setup rather than scheduled jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
